title: Create kawaii doomsday stories
description:
On desktops there is a lot of unused space between the logo and the basket icon. There could be story cards listing possible doomsday scenario's.

Acceptance criteria
1 Scenario's need to be kawaii, but they do not have to be accurate.
2 Scenario's are at most 3 paragraphs.
3 Scenariocards are visible on each viewport that has plenty of room between the logo and the basket. Show either 0, 1, 3 or 5 depending on available space.
4 If less than 5 scenariocards are shown, make sure they cycle every 10 seconds.
5 When you click a story card, a story page is shown. That page is centerered around a scenario.
5 Create 5 scenario's that are loosely based on popular belief, lore or legend. Incorporate the 3 products in a way so that each of the products would be beneficial for at least 1 of the scenario's.
